concerns.text: The `dataset.schema.yaml` contract defines a single field `protein_features` as an array of numbers, whereas the plan (and data-model.md) describe the processed unified matrix as having dynamic columns named `protein_<ID>` for each protein. This structural mismatch means the output will not validate against the contract.

The plan refers to success criterion `SC‑04` (data completeness), but the specification defines this criterion as `SC‑004`. The inconsistent identifier could cause traceability gaps between the plan and the spec.
